exact_consequences: The encoded complete one-shot lexical distribution is exactly independent of MPARSE and has zero derivative in that parameter.
Its supported adjacent ratio identifies markedness as -log(P(n+1)/P(n)).
The binary structural-versus-null response has an exact second-difference sign boundary at p=m(n+1).
Once markedness and one warranted binary response are available, MPARSE is recovered by p=mn+logit(r_n).
no_conclusion_if: the binary response task or a warranted grammar-to-response bridge is absent
the one-shot consumer includes an observed null candidate
separate binary responses are treated as one normalized lexical distribution
source_correspondence_boundary: The source supplies the separate one-shot and multiple-competition MaxEnt architectures, their formulas, and the stated MPARSE-learning gap. Exact deletion, adjacent-ratio recovery, curvature factorization, sign boundary, and binary-channel recovery are project derivations for the transcribed consumers.
verification_boundary: Lean proves the encoded normalization, derivatives, ratios, logistic factorization, curvature signs, and recovery equations. It does not prove the transcription, experimental response bridge, empirical adequacy, universal architecture, or literature priority.
withdrawal_condition: Withdraw or narrow the source application if MPARSE enters the authoritative one-shot normalizer or if the requested observations lack the separately warranted binary channel required by the recovery equation.
